# lifecycle-sync

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001 — A writer opens previews beside the editor or as tabs, beside the built-in preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-001.md) — When a writer or reader asks for a preview of a Markdown file, the Studio SHALL show its rendered preview in the editor group beside the text editor, or as a tab that stays on the file for the Open With choice, while leaving the built-in Markdown preview, its commands and its settings untouched.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003 — The side preview follows the active file and refreshes on demand](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-003.md) — When a writer moves to another Markdown file, the Studio SHALL switch the side preview to that file and name it in the panel title, and, when a reader asks for a refresh, render the shown document again from its current text and keep the reading position.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-005 — The preview updates in place as the text and its dependencies change](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-005.md) — When a writer changes a Markdown file, saved or not, or a file or a setting that an open preview depends on changes, the Studio SHALL update that preview in place with the typed text, changing only what changed, without saving the file or reopening the preview.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-007 — The reader knows the render state and why a preview has no source](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-007.md) — While a preview waits for a render, shows a render that failed, recovers from one or has no usable source file, the Studio SHALL say so in the preview and, for a missing source, say why.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010 — The panes scroll together and the reading position survives updates](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-010.md) — When a writer scrolls the text editor or a reader scrolls or clicks in the preview, the Studio SHALL bring the other pane to the same place in the document, as the scroll synchronization settings allow, and keep the preview on the same text when it updates, resizes or the text above it changes.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-014 — Previews come back after a reload, remember recent documents and leave nothing behind](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-014.md) — When VS Code restores its window, a reader returns to a document that a preview showed before, or a reader closes a preview or removes a workspace folder, the Studio SHALL bring the previews back on their documents at the reading state they had, stopping the work of the previews concerned and leaving every file as it was.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-019 — A preview outside a trusted workspace is safe to read](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-019.md) — When a reader opens a preview of a file in an untrusted workspace or outside any workspace folder, the Studio SHALL show it read-only.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-021 — The settings editor lists the Studio settings in clear groups](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-LIFE-021.md) — When a reader opens the Studio settings in the settings editor, the Studio SHALL list them in titled groups, each in a fixed order, with their defaults and descriptions.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
